items.title: NVIDIA Stocks Fall 3.91% as S&P Puts AA Rating on Downgrade Watch
items.summary: A governance review after Jensen Huang's exit and return now threatens a one-notch cut, while Moody's keeps its Aa1 rating steady.

items.title: S&P’s NVIDIA Warning is Backward Looking Governance Theater That Gives Everyone an Opportunity to Buy at $150
items.summary: NVIDIA lost its CEO, drew a credit warning, and watched its stock slide nearly a third in a month. So why does one investor keep buying more every week, and which three numbers convinced him the real story lies elsewhere?

items.title: Why Is S&P Global (SPGI) Up 2.5% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.summary: S&P Global (SPGI) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: Nvidia’s Reliance on Huang Could Now Hurt Its Credit Rating
items.summary: Jensen Huang resigned, returned within days, and refused to name a successor. Now a bond rater is asking whether one founder holds too much of Nvidia's fate, and a deadline, hearings, and a key price level will decide the answer.

items.title: Does S&P's Credit Warning Matter For Nvidia Stock?
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings put Nvidia on CreditWatch with negative implications on Wednesday, Nov 25. That is a formal warning that it could cut Nvidia's credit rating. A credit rating is a grade on how safely a company can repay what it borrows. S&P cited rising management and governance risk, not money trouble.

items.title: Nvidia Makes A Record $115.8 Billion In Revenue. Now S&P Warns Its Credit Rating Could Be Cut In 90 Days.
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings placed Nvidia's AA credit rating on negative CreditWatch, warning of a possible downgrade within 90 days as governance concerns persist despite record AI chip revenue.

items.title: How Investors Are Reacting To SiteOne Supply (SITE) Joining S&P Indices
items.summary: On 16 November 2026, SiteOne Landscape Supply was added to the S&P 600, S&P 1000 and S&P Composite 1500 indices, increasing its presence across small cap and broad US equity benchmarks. Index inclusion can reshape how SiteOne Landscape Supply is accessed by capital, since many funds track these benchmarks and adjust holdings to mirror them. items.title: S&P Weighs Nvidia Downgrade Despite Huang's Return. What Would a Cut Mean?
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings may cut Nvidia's AA credit rating within 90 days over board oversight concerns after Huang's return.
